# `sngl run` on html with no server language serves the static site it wrote:
# the page at /, not a listing of the directory.

serve run --platform html --lang none --opt listen=127.0.0.1:0 app.sngl
fetch $URL/
stdout '<!DOCTYPE html>'
stdout 'served statically'
! stdout 'index.html'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="served statically")
}
